caseName: General Motors Acceptance Corp. v. Hulbert
caseNameFull: General Motors Acceptance Corporation v. Hulbert, County Assessor of Canadian County
attorneys: Mr. D. I. Johnston for appellants. Messrs. Mac Q. Williamson, Attorney General of Oklahoma, and Bandell S. Cobb for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question. Columbus Southern Railway Co. v. Wright, 151 U. S. 470, 478-83; General American Tank Car Corp. v. Day, 270 U. S. 367, *591372. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.

Mr. D. I. Johnston for appellants. Messrs. Mac Q. Williamson, Attorney General of Oklahoma, and Bandell S. Cobb for appellee.
